description: Sourcebound lexical retrieval baseline with 10 sources and 50 queries.

documents.name: astronomy-field-notes.md
documents.content: Kepler telescope observations identify an exoplanet through repeated transit photometry. Follow-up spectroscopy estimates atmospheric composition while orbital period and stellar brightness constrain the habitable zone.

documents.name: fermentation-handbook.md
documents.content: Sourdough starter depends on wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria. Regular feeding, stable hydration, and warm fermentation produce carbon dioxide, acidity, and a reliable bread rise.

documents.name: distributed-systems-runbook.md
documents.content: A distributed service uses quorum consensus and leader election. During network partition, idempotent retries, bounded timeouts, replication lag monitoring, and a circuit breaker reduce cascading failure.

documents.name: urban-garden-plan.md
documents.content: The rooftop garden pairs tomatoes with basil, uses drip irrigation, and improves clay soil with compost. Crop rotation and native pollinator flowers reduce pests across the growing season.

documents.name: oral-history-methods.md
documents.content: An oral history interview begins with informed consent and open-ended questions. The researcher records provenance, creates a transcript, preserves the audio archive, and lets narrators review sensitive passages.

documents.name: accessibility-audit.md
documents.content: Accessible interfaces provide visible keyboard focus, semantic headings, sufficient color contrast, descriptive labels, and polite live regions. Screen reader testing complements automated WCAG checks.

documents.name: cashflow-forecast.md
documents.content: A rolling cash flow forecast separates accounts receivable from recognized revenue. Scenario planning tracks burn rate, payment timing, operating expenses, runway, and a minimum reserve.

documents.name: trail-navigation.md
documents.content: Backcountry navigation combines a topographic map, compass bearing, contour lines, and known landmarks. Hikers record a turnaround time, carry emergency shelter, and avoid relying on one battery-powered device.

documents.name: privacy-threat-model.md
documents.content: A privacy threat model maps data flow, trust boundaries, retention, and attacker capability. Data minimization, local storage, encryption, access control, and deletion reduce exposure.

documents.name: museum-cataloging.md
documents.content: Museum cataloging assigns an accession number, records object provenance, condition, dimensions, material, and conservation history. Controlled vocabulary and high-resolution photography support collection discovery.

documents.name: telescope-budget.md
documents.content: The astronomy department budget replaces a telescope mount and funds public observations but does not cover exoplanet spectroscopy.

documents.name: stellar-brightness-log.md
documents.content: A nightly log records stellar brightness, clouds, and telescope calibration without analyzing planetary transit photometry.

documents.name: space-policy-brief.md
documents.content: Space policy allocates launch capacity for science missions and discusses a broad habitable worlds program.

documents.name: orbital-mechanics.md
documents.content: Orbital period calculations use velocity and distance for satellites rather than atmospheric composition.

documents.name: bakery-inventory.md
documents.content: The bakery inventory tracks bread flour, hydration labels, delivery timing, and carbon dioxide canisters.

documents.name: yogurt-culture.md
documents.content: A yogurt culture uses lactic acid bacteria at a stable warm temperature but contains no wild yeast starter.

documents.name: bread-sales.md
documents.content: Weekly bread sales compare sourdough loaves, reliable suppliers, price, and customer demand.

documents.name: microbiology-lab.md
documents.content: The microbiology lab observes bacteria and yeast colonies while documenting acidity and sterile feeding media.

documents.name: network-inventory.md
documents.content: The network inventory lists distributed routers, replication hardware, maintenance windows, and bounded equipment warranties.

documents.name: incident-timeouts.md
documents.content: An incident report attributes cascading failure to retries without timeouts and recommends monitoring.

documents.name: database-replication.md
documents.content: Database replication lag increased during a partition, while an elected leader continued serving reads.

documents.name: service-design.md
documents.content: A service design uses idempotent operations, a circuit breaker, and consensus terminology in its architecture review.

documents.name: rooftop-permit.md
documents.content: A rooftop permit covers irrigation weight, growing containers, and seasonal access for an urban building.

documents.name: tomato-recipes.md
documents.content: Tomatoes and basil appear in summer recipes alongside bread, acidity, and garden herbs.

documents.name: soil-testing.md
documents.content: Soil testing measures clay, compost, drainage, and nutrients before planting flowers.

documents.name: pollinator-survey.md
documents.content: A pollinator survey counts native bees around flowers and notes crop pests across the season.

documents.name: interview-schedule.md
documents.content: The interview schedule lists narrators, review dates, open questions, and recording rooms.

documents.name: archive-storage.md
documents.content: The archive stores audio and transcript files with provenance metadata and access controls.

documents.name: research-consent.md
documents.content: Research participants provide informed consent before sensitive passages are collected.

documents.name: podcast-production.md

documents.name: design-review.md

documents.name: keyboard-shortcuts.md
documents.content: Keyboard shortcuts improve focus movement, while visible commands help frequent users.

documents.name: screen-reader-notes.md
documents.content: Screen reader notes cover live regions, descriptive labels, and semantic document landmarks.

documents.name: wcag-planning.md
documents.content: WCAG planning schedules automated checks and manual testing for contrast and keyboard access.

documents.name: revenue-report.md
documents.content: The revenue report reconciles recognized revenue, accounts receivable, payment timing, and expenses.

documents.name: runway-scenarios.md
documents.content: Scenario planning compares burn rate, runway, reserve levels, and operating cost assumptions.

documents.name: invoice-process.md
documents.content: Invoice processing monitors receivable aging, payment status, and minimum approval limits.

documents.name: annual-budget.md
documents.content: The annual budget estimates cash needs, revenue growth, operating expenses, and a reserve.

documents.name: compass-maintenance.md
documents.content: Compass maintenance checks the bearing dial and protective case before a trail trip.

documents.name: topographic-printing.md
documents.content: Map printing preserves topographic contour lines, scale, and known landmarks.

documents.name: emergency-shelter.md

documents.name: hiking-itinerary.md

documents.name: data-retention-policy.md

documents.name: encryption-key-plan.md

documents.name: security-data-flow.md

documents.name: storage-minimization.md

documents.name: conservation-report.md

documents.name: archive-vocabulary.md
